# set random number seed
```{r}
# Set random seed for reproducibility
set.seed(123)
```

# set sample size and trial number of each sub
```{r}
# Simulation parameters
N <- 50    # Number of subjects
T_sub <- 48    # Number of trials per subject
```

# set true parameters
## True group-level parameters
```{r}
mu_alpha <- 0.6    # Mean envy parameter
mu_tau <- 0.7     # Mean inverse temperature
mu_ep <- 0.4      # Mean adaptation rate

# Separate sigmas for each parameter
sigma_alpha <- 0.15
sigma_tau <- 0.08
sigma_epsilon <- 0.12
```

# Generate subject-level parameters
```{r}
generate_param <- function(mu, sigma, n) {
  # n is total subject N
  z_score <- qnorm(mu) # Step 1: Convert probability to z-score
  random_values <- rnorm(n, mean = z_score, sd = sigma) # Step 2: Generate random normal values
  probabilities <- pnorm(random_values)  # Step 3: Convert back to probability scale (0-1)
  return(probabilities)
}

# Generate parameters for each subject
alpha <- generate_param(mu_alpha, sigma_alpha, N)
tau <- generate_param(mu_tau, sigma_tau, N)
epsilon <- generate_param(mu_ep, sigma_epsilon, N)

# Initialize data frame
sim_data <- data.frame()

# Generate data for each subject
for (i in 1:N) {
  f <- 10.0  # Initial norm/initial prediction
  
  for (t in 1:T_sub) {
    offer <- sample(1:10, 1) # Generate a random offer between 1-10
    PE <- offer - f # Calculate prediction error
    
    util <- offer - alpha[i] * max(f - offer, 0) # Calculate utility
    p_accept <- 1/(1 + exp(-util * tau[i])) # Calculate acceptance probability
    
    decision <- rbinom(1, 1, p_accept)  # Generate decision
    
    f <- f + epsilon[i] * PE # Update norm based on RL
    
    sim_data <- rbind(sim_data, 
                      data.frame(subject = sprintf("sub-%d", i),
                               trial = t,
                               offer = offer,
                               accept = decision))
  }
}
```

# Convert to format needed for Stan
```{r}
offers <- matrix(0, nrow = N, ncol = T)
accepts <- matrix(0, nrow = N, ncol = T)
Tsubj <- rep(T, N)

for (i in 1:N) {
  subj_data <- subset(sim_data, subject == i)
  offers[i, 1:T] <- subj_data$offer
  accepts[i, 1:T] <- subj_data$accept
}

# Create list for Stan
stan_data <- list(
  N = N,
  T = T,
  Tsubj = Tsubj,
  offer = offers,
  accept = accepts
)

# Print true parameter values for later comparison
cat("True group-level parameters:\n")
cat("mu_alpha =", mu_alpha, "sigma_alpha =", sigma_alpha, "\n")
cat("mu_tau =", mu_tau, "sigma_tau =", sigma_tau, "\n")
cat("mu_epsilon =", mu_ep, "sigma_epsilon =", sigma_epsilon, "\n")
```
